description: Transitive dependencies of a symbol (forward-reachability on Calls+Imports edges). Optional relation='flows_to' traces semantic value flow from producer to consumer. Answers 'what does this symbol depend on?' — the complement of BlastRadius. Use to understand the full dependency chain before a refactor or to build a change-impact picture from the dependency side.

relation.description: Optional relation selector. Use 'flows_to' to trace semantic value flow from producer to consumer; omit for default dependency lineage.

symbol.description: Symbol ID whose transitive dependencies to enumerate.

name: Lineage
